source: docs/operations/dashboard-spec.md Block 2: profit = commission - fee - tax - cashback - event bonus + clawback netted; margin = profit / commission in basis points, half-up (Story 4.17)

cases.name: one withheld Shopee order of 100,000: fee 980, tax 10,000, cashback 71,216, profit 17,804 (17.80%)
an event bonus of 20,000 lowers it and a netted clawback of 9,263 raises it: 7,067 (7.07%)
a bonus larger than the operator share is a loss: -10,098 and a margin of -20.20% (half away from zero)
guest orders count in commission and profit, never in cashback (D5)
a period with no approved order: profit 0 and no margin
